posts.text:
Several of you suggested that I watch AES on meet the press. I did. A good speaker, hobbled only by the need to defend his positions. :)

I thought his best line was “we don’t have to live like this” but he kinda rushed past it. 

Gonna be very interested to see the debate with Rogers.
posts.summary: Praises speaker's rhetorical skill while noting defensive positioning
